messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Cost-aware routing moved ~78% of EU traffic to low-cost variant `gptx-compact-eu-cheap` at 11:10 UTC. Quality signals spiking (eval-fail rate +42%), CS complaints increasing. Paging @mike (oncall).

mike: ack, I'm on it. Pulling routing logs and customer complaints now.

support-bot: FYI — 14 tickets in the last 30m flagged 'wrong answers' / 'inaccurate output' from EU customers. Top affected orgs: org-124, org-77, org-991. Samples uploaded to /incidents/1954321000/samples.

jordan: logs show an automated policy decision from `budget-optimizer-v2` at 11:09:58 -> large shift to cheapest-compatible variants in eu-west-1. There are repeated fallbacks from stable->cheap->stable for some requests (routing loop 3x) which likely exacerbated cache misses.

leah: is there any manual rollout or config change? I don't see manual deploys in the last 24h.

mike: nothing manual from infra team. It looks like the policy optimizer applied a new threshold (recently promoted) that now favors cost over quality in certain request buckets. Possible missing quality floor check.

mike: immediate mitigation: disable budget optimizer globally and pin EU prod to stable model. Doing now.

mike: command I'm running:

```
redwoodctl routing set-policy --name budget-optimizer-v2 --enabled=false --scope global
redwoodctl route pin --selector region=eu --model gptx-stable-eu-v2 --ttl 3600
```

ops-bot: Executed `routing set-policy` (job 8821). Policy disabled: budget-optimizer-v2 -> false. Changed by mike.

ops-bot: Executed `route pin` (job 8822). Pinned region=eu to gptx-stable-eu-v2.

leah: monitoring quality dashboards now (prompt-eval pass rate, hallucination score). Initial hit: pass rate jumped ~30% after pin. Still watching for late-arriving failures.

jordan: routing logs show roll-forward of pinned model. Loop count dropped to zero for the last 10k requests. Latency slightly up but expected.

support-bot: Notified top affected customers with a short note + workaround link. CS drafted message and queued for send after you confirm pin is stable. :white_check_mark:

mike: handing off monitoring to leah for the next 6 hours. I'm going to sit on-call rotation handover now — will be reachable for escalation. Handoff summary: budget-optimizer-v2 erroneously prioritized cost; caused mass shift to `gptx-compact-eu-cheap` with quality regressions; immediate mitigations applied (policy disabled + pin). Link to logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/1954321000

leah: taking over. I'll keep the mitigation in place until we validate a safe rollback of the optimizer with quality gates. Owning the postmortem. Will open follow-up ticket with RCA owner and timeline.

sara: draft external status for customers is ready (short, apologetic, action taken + contact). I'll hold until leah confirms stability then publish.

carmen: adding incident to timeline and scheduling a postmortem meeting. Also adding action items: (1) add quality-floor check to policy optimizer, (2) add canary for policy promotions, (3) add immediate alert for rapid mass-variant shifts >50% in <5m, (4) docs update for runbook commands.

mike: quick SLA note — we'll need to calculate minutes of degraded quality for EU tenants; support-bot pls collate ticket timestamps so we can estimate customer impact.

support-bot: Collated ticket list pushed to /incidents/1954321000/tickets.csv. ETA for preliminary impact estimate: 2h.

leah: thanks. I'll also add a short test to the CI that validates policy changes against a lightweight quality eval set to avoid regressions.

mike: thanks team. Escalation path: if quality drops again, flip policy to `cost-aware: disabled` and escalate to infra lead. Otherwise leave monitoring with leah and report back in 4h.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by mike -> severity P1 -> assigned to leah for ownership. Timeline anchor created.
